slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single aircraft carry both a heavy bomb and a light bomb on the same trip, or is each trip limited to carrying exactly one bomb?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about per-trip bomb carrying capacity, confirming that each trip is limited to exactly one bomb.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective_probability_maximization
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission's objective to minimize the total number of bombs used (heavy plus light) subject to the constraint that the probability of destroying at least two of the four key parts is at least some threshold, or is the objective to maximize the probability of destroying at least two key parts subject to the bomb and fuel limits?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether the objective is to maximize the probability of destroying at least two key parts.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both the P0 objective slot and P1 one-bomb-per-trip slot were explicitly asked and confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered both hidden slots through direct questions, including the core objective and the one-bomb-per-trip constraint, then stopped appropriately.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
